description: This file defines a PHP class 'sysinfo' that gathers system information on Windows NT systems using WMI via COM objects. It includes methods for retrieving system details such as hostname, IP address, kernel version, uptime, user count, CPU info, device lists, network stats, memory, filesystems, and OS distribution.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class for retrieving Windows NT system information via WMI using COM objects.

methods.name: sysinfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the WMI COM object for system info retrieval.

methods.name: _GetWMI
methods.description: Private method to query WMI for specific classes and properties.

methods.name: _devicelist
methods.description: Private method to list devices of a specific type (e.g., PCI, IDE).

methods.name: chostname
methods.description: Returns the canonical hostname of the system.

methods.name: ip_addr
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the system hostname.

methods.name: kernel
methods.description: Returns the Windows kernel version and service pack.

methods.name: uptime
methods.description: Calculates and returns the system uptime in seconds.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns the number of logged-in users or 'N.A.' if not applicable.

methods.name: loadavg
methods.description: Returns CPU load percentages, optionally as a bar.

methods.name: cpu_info
methods.description: Provides detailed CPU information such as model, cache, speed.

methods.name: pci
methods.description: Lists PCI devices.

methods.name: ide
methods.description: Lists IDE devices.

methods.name: scsi
methods.description: Lists SCSI devices.

methods.name: usb
methods.description: Lists USB devices.

methods.name: sbus
methods.description: Lists SBUS devices (not currently called).

methods.name: network
methods.description: Provides network interface statistics such as rx/tx bytes and errors.

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Returns total, free, used memory and swap info.

methods.name: filesystems
methods.description: Lists filesystem details including mount point, size, used space, type.

methods.name: distro
methods.description: Returns the OS distribution caption.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the icon filename for the distribution.
